claims.claim: The cabinet envelope, required part names, joint definition, and target naming match the request.
claims.evidence: asset/model.urdf: robot drawer_cabinet; root carcass, drawer, handle; drawer_slide prismatic +X with limits [0, 0.24] m; handle_mount fixed. readings.json annotations/targets identify drawer_opening on tray_floor. Carcass bounds are X [-0.15, 0.15], Y [-0.21, 0.21], Z [0, 0.25] m, with 0.022 m legs. Overall depth including projecting handle is 0.37 m. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png, iso.png show the requested cabinet form.

claims.claim: The drawer provides the required open storage cavity in collision geometry.
claims.evidence: readings.json collision_boxes.tray_floor and asset/model.urdf define a solid 0.272 x 0.376 x 0.172 m box spanning Z [0.052, 0.224], filling the storage cavity. The visual design in asset/model.py has a 0.252 x 0.356 m interior, floor top Z=0.064 and rim Z=0.224 (0.160 m depth), but the physical cavity has no depth below the side/back rim.

claims.claim: Collision geometry follows the visual drawer without filling reachable empty space.
claims.evidence: probes/02_mesh.out: vertical intersections of the compiled drawer.obj at interior XY=(0.009, 0) are only Z=[0.052, 0.064]. readings.json gives the collision floor top as Z=0.224, 0.160 m above the visible floor. asset/model.urdf has only drawer_front_panel and the oversized tray_floor collisions for the drawer; the visible floor, back and side walls have been replaced by their enclosing solid box.

claims.claim: The unloaded moving assembly has clearance and remains held throughout its declared travel.
claims.evidence: readings.json: drawer/carcass side gaps 0.004 m, rear gap 0.005 m, minimum top and bottom gaps 0.002 m. Translation along +X increases rear clearance while preserving lateral/vertical gaps, so there is no intervening collision across [0, 0.24]. probes/01_drawer.out reports no cross-link overlaps at q=0, 0.06, 0.12, 0.18, 0.24 m. At full extension tray_floor X=[0.113, 0.385] and carcass_bottom X=[-0.15, 0.15], retaining 0.037 m overlap. Reopen reached 0.240255 m and settled to 0.239895 m without overlaps. This passes the joint-supported sliding criterion in REVIEW.md.

claims.claim: The separate handle provides an accessible neck and knob for grasping from above and pulling along +X.
claims.evidence: readings.json handles[0] is at (0.165, 0, 0.136). handle_neck is 0.040 m long and 0.012 m across, extending from front X=0.145 to knob X=0.185; knob is 0.035 m across. A 0.020 m-wide finger centered at X=0.165 occupies X=[0.155, 0.175], clearing carcass front X=0.150 by 0.005 m and knob by 0.010 m. Neck is within the 0.080 m gripper opening. Clearance increases with extension; handle_mount is fixed to drawer. probes/02_mesh.out confirms handle mesh bounds match these collision bounds; renders/iso.png and side.png show the projecting neck and knob.

claims.claim: An object placed at drawer_opening rests inside the tray and can be closed inside the cabinet.
claims.evidence: readings.json place_targets[0] sets lip_local=(0.145, 0, 0.224). At q=0.24 the scenario XY is (0.265, 0). probes/01_drawer.out: a 0.040 m cube dropped there settles at (0.265, 0, 0.24394), unchanged after another 60 frames, with total drawer contact force about 0.980 N. Its bottom is Z=0.22394, at the side/back rim rather than on the visible floor Z=0.064. Driving closed reaches q=0.050974 and after release q=0.059365 instead of 0; cube remains at Z=0.24394. This height also overlaps the carcass top slab Z=[0.232, 0.250] during insertion.

metrics.feedback: Replace the single enclosing tray_floor collision with separate boxes for the actual thin floor, back and two side walls, retaining drawer_front_panel. Set tray_floor size to (0.272, 0.376, 0.012) at (0.009, 0, 0.058), so its top is Z=0.064. Add tray_back size (0.010, 0.376, 0.172) at (-0.122, 0, 0.138), and tray_left_side/tray_right_side size (0.252, 0.010, 0.172) at (0.009, +/-0.183, 0.138), matching the visible tray. Regenerate drawer_opening from the corrected floor so lip_local has Z=0.064. Preserve the existing handle, joint limits and carcass clearance. Repeat the full travel and 4 cm object placement/close/reopen checks: the object must settle on the visible floor inside the rim and the loaded drawer must reach closed q=0.
